% A revtex4-2 preprint for an aip journal, in one column with wider
% spacing, with a single appendix from \appendix*, and a section after it
% with no title, whose heading is "Appendix" alone. aip writes its
% bibliography's \bibdata line twice, and bibtex fails, unless the
% document has a \bibliography, here with nothing cited.
\documentclass[aip,jcp,preprint]{revtex4-2}
\begin{document}
\title{Revhead preprint}
\author{Someone}
\maketitle
\section{First section}
Text of the first section.
\subsection{A subsection}
Text of the subsection.
\appendix*
\section{Only appendix}
Text of the only appendix.
\section{}
Text of the bare appendix.
\bibliography{test-bibindex}
\end{document}
